newsitem.title: USA: CenterPoint Properties to restructure as trust.
newsitem.headline: CenterPoint Properties to restructure as trust.

text.p: CenterPoint Properties Corp said Thursday it will restructure the corporation as a trust which is intended to result in substantial tax savings in future years.
The technical restructuring will not affect CenterPoint's election to be taxed as a real estate investment trust (REIT).

The restructuring will be accomplished by a merger of CenterPoint into a newly-formed Maryland real estate investment trust, to be known as CenterPoint Properties Trust. After completion of the merger, the trust will include all assets and liabilities of CenterPoint, and all outstanding securities of CenterPoint will be converted into identical securities of the trust. The securities will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange.
The merger requires the approval of the holders of two-thirds of CenterPoint's common stock.
Shareholders will be asked to approve the proposed restructuring at a special meeting scheduled for October 1.
If approved and if all other conditions are satisfied, the restructuring is expected to become effective in October.
CenterPoint is the largest owner and developer of industrial real estate in Chicago.
